g.text: RR8 myeloid-enriched forebrain | eight exposure donors | age-adjusted models and cell-selection sensitivities
Circles: 3 months; triangles: 8 months. Highlighted genes were selected after reviewing the full panel; the full 151-target table is retained.
Sensor, adaptor and effector transcripts do not establish protein activation. Processing day, enriched-cell mixtures and ambient RNA remain limitations.
